up: Retrieve approved drugs (where max_phase = 4) that have drug indications associated with a maximum clinical trial phase of 3. For each drug-indication pair, return the drug's preferred name (pref_name), the drug's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the indication's MeSH ID (mesh_id), MeSH heading (mesh_heading), EFO ID (efo_id), and EFO term (efo_term).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_id, di.efo_term FROM drug_indication di JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.max_phase_for_ind = 3
